qualifier: SLC6 monoamine transporters and their defects
name: SLC6 monoamine transporter reuptake and transporter disorders
rationale: Members concern neurotransmitter transport by norepinephrine/dopamine transporters (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) including their disease variants and vesicular loading, unlike confusables centred on catecholamine synthesis, degradation or generic monoamine transport.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: All members describe TCR-proximal and downstream signaling and its tuning by CD28, CTLA4 and BTLA, distinguishing it from BCR signaling, T cell enrichment modules and thymocyte development confusables.

name: Ear, nose and cranial sensory placode development
rationale: Members cover inner, middle and outer ear, olfactory/nose, cranial ganglion and GnRH neuron migration development, all placode-associated sensory structures, unlike gland, face/limb or eye-focused confusables.

qualifier: G protein and presynaptic receptor control of glutamate and GABA
name: Presynaptic receptor modulation of glutamate and GABA release
rationale: Members concern presynaptic control of glutamate/GABA release via G protein-coupled receptors, Gbeta/gamma channel regulation, kainate receptors and calcium, unlike confusables on vesicle release machinery, postsynaptic ionotropic receptors or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation with FGF restraint
rationale: Members regulate vessel sprouting, branching and endothelial proliferation, and uniquely include negative regulation of FGF production and chemotaxis, distinguishing it from VEGF/Tie2-driven or endothelial activation/apoptosis confusables.

name: Nuclear estrogen receptor gene expression response
rationale: Members describe estrogen-driven transcriptional programmes and nuclear receptor signaling (with progesterone receptor and AP-2 targets), unlike confusables on GPER1/estrous cycle or androgen receptor signaling.

qualifier: classical and alternative pathways, positive regulation
name: Complement activation via classical and alternative pathways
rationale: All members concern activation of the complement cascade, specifically classical antibody-mediated and alternative pathways and their positive regulation, unlike confusables on lectin/C3-C5 activation or negative complement regulation.

name: Organic ion transport and xenobiotic efflux
rationale: Members cover organic cation/anion and dicarboxylate transport plus xenobiotic export including at the blood-brain barrier, distinguishing it from monocarboxylate transport and SLCO-based drug ADME confusables.

name: Semaphorin 3A axon repulsion and nerve branching
rationale: Members concern Sema3A-plexin repulsive signaling via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition with microtubule depolymerization and nerve branching, unlike netrin, ephrin or collateral sprouting confusables.

core: Sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism
name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium metabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine/sulfide catabolism, glutathione synthesis and turnover with their deficiencies, and selenium compound metabolism, unlike general amino acid, choline/carnitine or urea cycle confusables.

name: Nucleotide phosphorylation and di/triphosphate interconversion
rationale: Members centre on kinase-driven conversion of nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates and regulation of nucleotide synthesis, unlike NAD, pyrophosphate/inositol phosphate or creatine confusables.

name: ADP P2Y purinergic signaling in platelet activation
rationale: All members concern ADP signaling through P2Y1 and P2Y12 driving platelet activation, distinguishing it from integrin, GPVI and collagen adhesion-driven platelet confusables.

name: REM, non-REM sleep and wakefulness regulation
rationale: Members regulate sleep and wake states with orexin neuropeptide signaling, unlike confusables on feeding, social behaviours, circadian clock transcription or generic neuropeptide signaling.

name: mRNA stabilization and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members concern mRNA stabilization (CRD, IGF2BPs, 3'UTR) and decapping-driven 5'-to-3' decay, unlike confusables on deadenylation, ARE-binding destabilization or NMD/export.

qualifier: heart tube and second heart field
name: Embryonic heart tube and second heart field development
rationale: Members cover cardiogenesis, heart tube looping, second heart field specification and ventricle formation, unlike confusables on outflow tract, conduction system, trabeculation or valve development.

qualifier: SHC1, GRB2, PI3K and PLCG1 adaptor events
name: EGFR and ERBB2 signaling through docking adaptors
rationale: Members describe EGFR/ERBB2 signal propagation through adaptors and effectors (SHC1, GRB2, GRB7, PI3K, PLCG1, GAB1), unlike confusables centred on ERBB3/ERBB4 or MET receptor signaling.

qualifier: intracellular domain transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants
name: Notch intracellular domain signaling and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants
rationale: Members concern Notch receptor processing and NICD-driven transcription including constitutive NOTCH1 cancer mutants, unlike confusables on generic regulated intramembrane proteolysis of p75NTR, ERBB4 or NOTCH4 activation.

name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and endocannabinoid turnover
rationale: Members cover synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and hydrolysis of glycerophospholipids and acylglycerols including endocannabinoid metabolism, unlike sphingolipid, lipid transfer or lipid droplet/triglyceride storage confusables.

core: Protein lipidation for trafficking and secretion
name: Rab geranylgeranylation and Wnt ligand acylation for secretion
rationale: Members concern Rab prenylation/activation and PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion at the Golgi, unlike RAS processing or Hedgehog palmitoylation confusables.

name: Translational initiation repression in unfolded protein response
rationale: Members concern stress-regulated inhibition of translation initiation within the UPR, unlike confusables centred on ATF6, ATF4, XBP1 or CREB3 transcriptional arms.

name: Type I interferon antiviral response with ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members describe interferon-stimulated antiviral gene programmes including ISG15 conjugation, unlike confusables on OAS/PKR, RIG-I sensing, cytosolic DNA sensing or viral replication restriction.

name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial mRNA, tRNA and rRNA and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial transcription/translation/DNA, pseudouridylation or nuclear tRNA processing.

qualifier: suppression of TGF-beta response and ECM assembly
name: Fibrotic matrix remodeling and TGF-beta response suppression
rationale: Members concern wound-healing connective tissue replacement and negative regulation of TGF-beta response and ECM assembly, unlike confusables on myofibroblast/fibroblast behaviour or endothelial regulation.

name: Ureteric bud and nephric duct morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern nephric/mesonephric duct formation and ureteric bud outgrowth, elongation and branching, unlike confusables on metanephric mesenchyme proliferation and survival or intermediate mesoderm.

name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus ammonium transport
rationale: Members concern red cell O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh glycoprotein-mediated ammonium transport, unlike surfactant, heme biosynthesis or iron homeostasis confusables.
